turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Why?
We're here because an AI wrote his essay, and I'd bet an AI is writing your side of this meeting too.
I'm sorry? You've just told me my son didn't write his own essay, so show me what you have.
Owen. Show me the evidence, Hale.
